limits: First inactive-tab attempt timed out ~1RAF/s; preserved, not accepted. Browser-state visible/focused alone failed to expose inactive tab; management showed active:false until own window move.
Diagnostic opt-in also enabled existing WebGPU shader inventory/frame hooks; cannot compare these FPS against plain manual test.
One actual multiplayer relation, night, manual medium after initial auto/low; no3session test or worker A/B.
Environment events sampled >=25ms and cadence1s; they identify entire controller envelopes, not exclusive functions. Post-ready quality transition includes cinematic setup.
No actual GPU timestamps; CPU wall timing includes GC/scheduling.
